notes: Get back to what you were doing, in one tap. New: a Favorites tab, next to Settings, opens straight onto the stations you've actually favourited - no more finding the category filter and picking "Favorites" by hand. New: a "Continue listening" card sits above the station list, always there and reachable in one swipe - it remembers your most recent station, falls back to a favourite, then to whatever's on screen, with its own actions for playing a favourite or shuffling favourites. New: the mini player never disappears - when nothing's playing it says so, with a Resume action that picks up your last station instead of just going blank. Screen reader, considerably less noisy. New: TalkBack Simple Mode, one switch in a new Accessibility section - minimal announcements, list instead of grid, quieter badges - and it remembers what you had set before, to restore if you turn it back off. New: station and channel rows share the same two actions, Play and Favourite, with Share, Copy and Remove a tap further in. Fixed: favouriting a station reads out properly, and adding one now offers Undo exactly like removing one always did. Fixed: the buffering spinner finally says something - it used to hand TalkBack nothing at all while a stream connected, and now announces "Connecting." Fixed: the stale-connection banner is a real button now, and tapping it retries. Playback. New: Smart Rewind on Resume - pause a podcast or a local track for more than a minute and Tarang rewinds a few seconds when you press play again, so you don't come back mid-sentence. New: stop playback when you swipe Tarang away, if you'd rather it not keep playing in the background - off by default. New: share a station, channel, video or podcast episode as a real, playable link from the expanded player, not just its title. Local Music. New: hide anything under 30 seconds - the ringtones and voice notes that used to clutter the list. New: choose whether video files show up here at all. New: clear the cached artwork and thumbnails from Settings when it's taking up space you'd rather have back. Everywhere. New: the top bar gets out of the way while you scroll, and returns when you scroll back up, on every main screen.
